form.name: PUBLIC_KEY
form.label: Optional ssh public key, which will automatically be added to authorizedkeys.

form.name: PUBLIC_KEY_FILE
form.label: Optionally specify a file containing the public key (works with docker secrets).

form.name: PUBLIC_KEY_DIR
form.label: Optionally specify a directory containing the public keys (works with docker secrets).

form.name: PUBLIC_KEY_URL
form.label: Optionally specify a URL containing the public key.

form.name: SUDO_ACCESS
form.label: Set to true to allow linuxserver.io, the ssh user, sudo access. Without USERPASSWORD set, this will allow passwordless sudo access.

form.name: PASSWORD_ACCESS
form.label: Set to true to allow user/password ssh access. You will want to set USERPASSWORD or USERPASSWORDFILE as well.

form.name: USER_PASSWORD
form.label: Optionally set a sudo password for linuxserver.io, the ssh user. If this or USERPASSWORDFILE are not set but SUDOACCESS is set to true, the user will have passwordless sudo access.

form.name: USER_PASSWORD_FILE
form.label: Optionally specify a file that contains the password. This setting supersedes the USERPASSWORD option (works with docker secrets).

form.name: LOG_STDOUT
form.label: Set to true to log to stdout instead of file.
